steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the event type from RFP to Auction.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is available; the exact forward template cannot be selected confidently.
Add the requested product as the first line item.
Render and populate the auction pricing sheet before editing the requested quantity.
Enter the very large quantity directly into the first sheet row and advance with Tab.
Verify the quantity is retained and displayed with thousands separators.
Check that the sheet has no NaN, undefined, raw IDs, server error, or page crash after the large value is entered.
Add one available QA vendor so the event can be published.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Check the published event page for malformed values, errors, or crashes after publishing.
